exposure: Biochemical biomarkers (pH, base excess, serum lactate, AST, ALT, PT, APTT, creatinine, urea, troponin T (TnT), fibrinogen, platelet counts)
outcome: Levels of biochemical biomarkers (pH, base excess, serum lactate, AST, ALT, PT, APTT, creatinine, urea, troponin T (TnT), fibrinogen, platelet counts)
cohort: A total of 57 cooled newborns with moderate or severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).
finding: Biomarker levels differed significantly between moderate and severe HIE groups, allowing for HIE severity evaluation, and severe HIE infants had significantly reduced survival (75%) compared to moderate HIE infants (100%), though individual biomarker levels did not correspond with future prognosis.
